# Bluom

> Bluom is an all-in-one health and fitness app unifying nutrition, training, sleep, mood, menstrual cycle, and supplement tracking into a single mobile app for iOS and Android.

Bluom replaces the need for multiple separate apps (calorie counter, macro tracker, workout logger, habit tracker, cycle tracker, meditation app) with one connected system.

## Key features
- AI photo calorie scanner: point a camera at a meal to detect food, portions, and macros automatically.
- Macro and nutrition tracker with a 1M+ food database in 14 languages, plus barcode scanning.
- Workout and fitness tracker: exercise logging, MET-based calorie burn, Strava sync, 1000+ exercise library.
- Personalized nutrition, fitness, and wellness plans generated from user biometrics and goals.
- Wellness tools: guided meditation, sleep tracking, mood/journal tracking, habit tracker with streaks.
- Women's health mode: cycle tracking, pregnancy week tracker, menopause mode with phase-aware insights.
- Men's health mode: supplement stack builder, cycle phase tracking, pill reminders, habit quitter tools.
- Fasting timers (16:8, 18:6, 20:4) and fasting/autophagy education content.

## Pricing
- Free plan: $0/month, includes basic meal, workout, and cycle tracking.
- Premium plan: $11.99/month (US pricing may vary by platform/region), includes the AI photo calorie scanner, unlimited AI coach messages, premium recipes, video workouts, and advanced analytics.
